Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Implement core Docker API and Port Scanning functionality

Major implementations in this release:

Docker API Client (COMPLETE):
- Full libcurl-based REST API client for Docker daemon
- Cross-platform socket support (Unix socket for Linux/macOS, named pipe for Windows)
- Complete container lifecycle: list, start, stop, restart, remove
- Image operations: pull, list, remove, exists check
- Network and volume management
- Registry authentication support
- Comprehensive JSON parsing with nlohmann/json
- Robust error handling and logging

Port Scanner (COMPLETE):
- Platform-specific implementations for Windows and Linux
- Windows: Uses iphlpapi.h (GetExtendedTcpTable/GetExtendedUdpTable)
- Linux: Parses /proc/net/tcp and /proc/net/udp
- Process name resolution for port owners
- Port conflict detection algorithm
- Intelligent alternative port suggestion
- Available port finder with range support
- Groups ports by container/process

Build System Enhancements:
- CMake FetchContent for automatic dependency management
- nlohmann/json v3.11.3 integration
- Platform-specific library linking (ws2_32, iphlpapi, pthread)
- Cross-platform compiler support

Infrastructure:
- Build status documentation
- External dependencies management
- Improved error handling throughout

This release provides a solid foundation for container management
and network diagnostics. The Docker API client can fully communicate
with Docker daemon, and the port scanner can detect conflicts before
they happen - the core value proposition of this application.

Next priorities: Update Checker, SQLite Database, GUI implementation
